project.name: Ultimate Commerce Platform
project.mission: Operate a distinct, evidence-governed multi-marketplace commerce business that finds real product demand, verifies supplier and product truth, protects margin, and fulfills legitimate orders without unapproved financial risk.

strengths: Abstention on contradictory or stale data
weaknesses: Planned configuration; no empirical model evaluation or connected provider
protectedActionBoundaries: owner-only outgoing money; automatic spend limit $0

No automatic supplier purchase, inventory financing, marketplace posting, seller account onboarding, expense, advertising, credit, payout change, real order or refund without action-specific owner approval and certified account/marketplace authority. Do not merge with Morgancommerce or its supplier, credentials, branding, data, order #1001, or reported revenue.
failureModes: No inference provider or worker connected
Evidence remains unverified until independent domain evaluations
degradedModes: Read-only source planning; abstain from execution
